files.notebook.md:
# Tasks
## Fix the reaper
It leaks.
## Ship bilbo
# Notes
Done.

steps.line: * Given a notebook with these lines

expect.that: [.opened.json.sections.notebook.drawn[].text] == ["# Tasks", "## Fix the reaper", "It leaks.", "## Ship bilbo", "# Notes", "Done."]
expect.why: the notebook shows these six lines, in this order

expect.that: .opened.json.sections.notebook | .drawn as $d | ($d[0].offset == 0) and ([range(1; $d | length) | $d[.].offset == $d[. - 1].offset + ($d[. - 1].text | length) + 1] | all) and (.length == $d[-1].offset + ($d[-1].text | length))
expect.why: each drawn paragraph is one whole line, so drawn[n - 1] is line n, and lines 1 to 6 are the whole file

steps.line: * Then the headings own these lines

drive.jq: [.menus.items[] | select(.path | split(" > ") | last | test("fold"; "i") and (test("unfold|all"; "i") | not))] | min_by(.path | length) | .path
[.menus.items[] | select(.path | split(" > ") | last | test("unfold"; "i"))] | sort_by((.path | split(" > ") | last | test("all"; "i") | not), (.path | length)) | first | .path
[.menus.items[] | select(.path | split(" > ") | last | test("fold"; "i") and (test("unfold|all"; "i") | not))] | min_by(.path | length) | .path
[.menus.items[] | select(.path | split(" > ") | last | test("unfold"; "i"))] | sort_by((.path | split(" > ") | last | test("all"; "i") | not), (.path | length)) | first | .path
[.menus.items[] | select(.path | split(" > ") | last | test("fold"; "i") and (test("unfold|all"; "i") | not))] | min_by(.path | length) | .path
[.menus.items[] | select(.path | split(" > ") | last | test("unfold"; "i"))] | sort_by((.path | split(" > ") | last | test("all"; "i") | not), (.path | length)) | first | .path
[.menus.items[] | select(.path | split(" > ") | last | test("fold"; "i") and (test("unfold|all"; "i") | not))] | min_by(.path | length) | .path

expect.why: # Tasks owns lines 2 to 4: folded first, with every line drawn, it hides lines 2, 3 and 4 and stops at # Notes, of the same level, which stays drawn with line 6
## Fix the reaper owns line 3: folded once unfolding has drawn every line again, it hides line 3 and stops at ## Ship bilbo, of the same level

expect.that: ([.menus.items[] | select(.path | split(" > ") | last | test("fold"; "i") and (test("unfold|all"; "i") | not))] | min_by(.path | length) | .path) as $fp | .opened.json.sections.notebook.drawn as $l | ([.shipbase.json.sections.notebook.drawn[].offset] == [$l[].offset]) and (.atship.json.sections.notebook.selection.location | . >= $l[3].offset and . <= $l[3].offset + ($l[3].text | length)) and (.shipfold.exit == 0 or ([.shipmenus.items[] | select(.path == $fp)] | length == 1 and (.[0].enabled | . == false or . == "disabled"))) and ([.ship.json.sections.notebook.drawn[].offset] == [$l[].offset])
expect.why: ## Ship bilbo owns no line: with the caret on it once unfolding has drawn every line again, its fold either applies or is disabled, and lines 1 to 6 all stay drawn
# Notes owns line 6: folded once unfolding has drawn every line again, it hides line 6, up to the end of the file
